## Changes

- **Dimmer starter brightness.** The starter `keypad.json` now sets the keypad's panel brightness to 50 instead of 70. As before, tmux-legion writes the starter pages only when `keypad.json` doesn't exist yet, so an existing file keeps its own `brightness`.

## Maintenance

- Builds against [mx-keypad v0.10.1](https://github.com/hawkish/mx-keypad/releases/tag/v0.10.1), which renders key labels on systems without Arial, including most Linux installs. They used to come out blank. Upgrade the mx-keypad agent too, since it draws the keys.

## Install

### Nix flake

```nix
# Pin to a release tag (recommended); drop the ref to track the default branch.
inputs.tmux-legion.url = "github:hawkish/tmux-legion/v0.10.1";
```

### Manual and TPM-style

```bash
git clone https://github.com/hawkish/tmux-legion ~/.tmux/plugins/tmux-legion
cd ~/.tmux/plugins/tmux-legion && cargo build --release
echo 'run-shell ~/.tmux/plugins/tmux-legion/tmux-legion.tmux' >> ~/.tmux.conf
```

Upgrading needs a tmux config reload, not just a rebuild — see [After upgrading](https://github.com/hawkish/tmux-legion#after-upgrading). The [README](https://github.com/hawkish/tmux-legion#install) covers Claude Code hooks, the agent skill, and the pi extension.
